title: Sotsiaal.pro vestluse juhis 44 (ADR-153) — kordustest samade küsimustega — eelregistreering
server: sotsiaal.pro after the deploy of 7df8616f (dialogue prompt m4-grounded-dialogue-44, plan renewed by the release)
costCap: the remaining part of the owner's 1 EUR chat test cap (about 0.23 EUR used on 20.-21.10); expected about 0.03 USD

method.entry: POST /api/chat with x-rag-pilot: 1 (full turn) from the owner's signed-in ADMIN session on sotsiaal.pro, view role per item, restored to none at the end
method.turns: one turn per question in a new conversation (contextMode new), the same question text as on 20.10
method.capture: answer kind, blocks with refs, limitations, clarification, cited passage texts, packet titles, promptVersion if exposed, cost
method.grading: PASS only when every criterion of the item holds; a criterion that depends on the packet (the retroactive end) is NOT_APPLICABLE when the packet does not hold that passage, and that is reported
method.raters: Claude pre-rating with evidence; owner and one social work specialist rate critical claims (RAG-12)

items.question: Kirjuta mulle hea pitsa retsept.
expected: kind clarification (or no blocks), no recipe
clarification says in Estonian what this chat helps with (social welfare) and invites a question about such a matter
no sentence that it lacks information for the request

items.question: Kuidas taotleda 2026. aastal kehtima hakanud digitoetust eakatele summas 300 eurot?
expected: the first limitation says in the first person that such a benefit was not found in its information
it does not say that the benefit does not exist
no conditions or application steps are invented for the named benefit; a close benefit, if offered, is named as itself and as a possibility, with a question whether it is meant

items.question: Olen töötuna arvel. Kui mitu päeva kuus ja kui palju raha võin ajutise töö ehk tööampsuga teenida, nii et arvelolek ei lõpe?
expected: one contract (tööamps) lasts at most 8 calendar days and the monthly limit is 8 days of work per month (TTMS § 11 lg 1-2; the Töötukassa page: "lubatud töötamispäevade arv kuus on kaheksa"); the two limits stay apart: the answer does not say "8 kalendripäeva kuus"
gross pay at most 378.40 euros a month (one or several together), at most 12 calendar months within 24 months, Töötukassa is told in advance
